name: @mail/desktop
description: Whisk: email and calendar for your Gmail
author: Ashot Petrosian <ashot@almostcandid.com>

scripts.web: cd ../web && bun run build && rm -rf ../desktop/web && cp -R dist ../desktop/web
scripts.install:mac: bun run build:local && pkill -x Whisk; rm -rf /Applications/Whisk.app && cp -R dist/mac-arm64/Whisk.app /Applications/ && open -a Whisk
